title: Slacker
description: Filmmaker Richard Linklater uses a string of mostly amateur actors to show varieties of a type: the new bohemian.

title: The Gambler II
description:
S01 E01 — The Adventure Continues
Brady Hawkes, Billy Montana and Jeremiah Hawkes are on a train bound for a huge gambling event when the train is taken over by a gang of vicious killers in search of money.

title: The Lawnmower Man
description: A scientist uses an intellectually disabled gardener as a guinea pig in his experiments with intelligence enhancing drugs and virtual reality. The man transforms into a genius, but not without side effects.

title: Her Smell
description: Becky Something is a talented but self-destructive musician who seems determined to alienate everyone around her -- even at the cost of her own band's success.

title: Jobs
description: In 1976, college dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher) and technical wizard Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad) spark a revolution with the invention of the Apple computer, built in the garage of Jobs' parents.

title: The BeastMaster
description: Prehistoric Darwin uses ESP with animals to save a slave girl from a sorcerer.

title: Sophie's Choice
description: A Southern writer (Peter MacNicol) lives in Brooklyn with an Auschwitz survivor (Meryl Streep) and her mad lover (Kevin Kline).

title: 10th and Wolf
description: An ex-Marine (James Marsden) faces a dilemma after he returns to South Philadelphia and discovers his brother (Brad Renfro) and cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) are entangled in the mob.

title: The Road to Wellville
description: Dr. John Kellogg (Anthony Hopkins) treats a young couple (Bridget Fonda, Matthew Broderick) for their imagined ailments at his Michigan sanitorium circa 1907.

title: House
description: In an effort to avoid spending time with her father and his creepy new lover, young Gorgeous (Kimiko Ikegami) resolves to visit her aunt's remote mansion, where supernatural events occur almost immediately.

title: The Ron Clark Story
description: A small-town teacher (Matthew Perry) moves to New York and makes a difference in the lives of his students.

title: Once Upon a Time in China II
description: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

title: The Marksman
description: Jim is a former Marine who lives a solitary life as a rancher along the Arizona-Mexican border. But his peaceful existence soon comes crashing down when he tries to protect a boy on the run from members of a vicious cartel.

title: Basmati Blues
description: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

title: Until Death
description: After waking from a coma, a troubled detective (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must save his kidnapped wife from the men he tried to apprehend.

title: Plan 9 From Outer Space
description: Filmmaker Ed Wood Jr.'s laughable tale of alien invaders and resurrected corpses in the San Fernando Valley.

title: Triple 9
description: Criminals and some crooked cops hatch a devious scheme to use an honest lawman as a pawn for a heist.

title: Rough Magic
description: A sleazy politician sends an agent (Russell Crowe) after his ex-fiancee (Bridget Fonda), who fled to Mexico with incriminating film of him.

title: Bloodfist
description: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

title: Holy Motors
description: Driven around Paris by a loyal driver (Edith Scob), a mysterious man (Denis Lavant) dresses up in costumes and plays a number of strange, semiscripted roles.

title: The Big Sleep
description: Private eye Philip Marlowe falls into a porno/blackmail/murder case in the 1970s London.

title: Rendel: Dark Vengeance
description: Rendel, a masked superhero, becomes blinded by his desire for revenge against a sinister criminal organization.

title: Red Riding: 1974
description: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a missing-child case that mirrors that of a series of child abductions and murders that took place in previous years.

title: Hopscotch
description: An ex-CIA agent (Walter Matthau) and his lover (Glenda Jackson) write a book about the agency, one jump ahead of agents sent to stop them.

title: Sliding Doors
description: After a series of misfortunes, a woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) with an unfaithful boyfriend (John Lynch) experiences an alternate reality.

title: Chef
description: A chef (Jon Favreau) quits his job at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant and starts a food-truck business in Miami with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), his best friend (John Leguizamo) and his son.

title: Squadron 303: The Battle of Britain
description: Polish fighter pilots defend the United Kingdom during the Battle of Britain.

title: The Gambler
description: An Old West poker player (Kenny Rogers) acquires a sidekick (Bruce Boxleitner) and sets out to help the son he never knew.

title: Jane Got a Gun
description: With help from her boozing ex-lover (Joel Edgerton), a woman (Natalie Portman) tries to defend her injured husband (Noah Emmerich) from a vengeful outlaw (Ewan McGregor) and his gang of killers in the Old West.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.

title: The Heart of Me
description: A woman (Helena Bonham Carter) has an affair with her older sister's (Olivia Williams) husband (Paul Bettany) and bears his child.

title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part II: The Metal Years
description: Filmmaker Penelope Spheeris scans the heavy-metal music scene: Alice Cooper, Lizzy Borden, Poison, Aerosmith, Kiss, Ozzy Osbourne.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

title: Infernal Affairs II
description: In this prequel to the original, a rebel policeman sets up the infiltration of Triad gangs and tries to bring down a corrupt cop working for the Triad boss.

title: Raise the Titanic
description: A U.S. admiral (Jason Robards) and his team (Richard Jordan, David Selby) compete with Russians in an attempt to salvage the luxury liner.

title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
description: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

title: College
description: To impress his sweetheart (Anne Cornwall), a bookworm (Buster Keaton) goes out for baseball and crew.

title: Piranha
description: Two people (Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies) unwittingly free a mad military scientist's (Kevin McCarthy) mutant fish near a summer camp and resort lake.

title: A Midnight Clear
description: A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.
